data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'K-M-L', meaning 'to perfect' or 'to complete'. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes the continuous pursuit of spiritual and moral excellence. The name Kamaliyyah carries the meaning “Perfection, Excellence” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kamaliyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody perfection, excellence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
